backup.production_rule: Guest guide v9 backend (s137), two migrations. 20261207000000_guide_v9_secrets.sql adds one table guide_staff_sessions (RLS on, no policy, no privilege for anon, authenticated or service_role, never more than 50 rows, each row carries a pin_fp fingerprint of the staff code), three functions guide_staff_session_v1(text, text), guide_secrets_v1(text) (VOLATILE, POST only), get_public_settings() (SECURITY DEFINER, search_path empty, executable by anon and authenticated only, not by service_role or PUBLIC) and one pg_cron job weather-proxy-warm every 10 minutes calling the weather-proxy edge function with net.http_get. 20261207000100_verify_admin_pin_bound.sql REPLACES the body of the existing public.verify_admin_pin(text, text) (same signature, return shapes, security definer, search_path; grants restated by name: anon, authenticated, service_role execute, public none) so the throttle keys on the request address (IPv6 by /64; 20 wrong codes per address in 15 minutes), a null or empty code writes no row, old rows are trimmed inline and a global cap of 400 attempts per 15 minutes applies, and adds the index admin_auth_attempts_attempted_at_idx on public.admin_auth_attempts. verify_admin_pin is called by the live guest guide admin gate and by the v9 staff sign-in fallback (no other live caller), so its behaviour change is part of this release (see docs/s137/GUIDE-V9-SECRETS.md, R7 caller inventory). app_settings is read, never written.
backup.notes: Apply after guide_v8_messages_analytics (20261206000000) and s136_followups (20261206100000) are live (both are, 2026-11-25). The migrations carry no begin/commit (the runner wraps them). Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour). The first migration guard raises 55000 where guide v8 or verify_admin_pin is missing or guide_staff_sessions already exists; the second refuses unless the live verify_admin_pin body md5 is ca4ade3f91d42574c9176d2331e10f41 and the index does not exist. STORAGE: guide_staff_sessions is bounded at 50 rows by the mint itself (a few kilobytes). public.admin_auth_attempts (the verify_admin_pin attempt log, the only table that grows from anon traffic) is bounded by the second migration: at most 401 rows per 15 minutes (an insert is allowed while the last 15 minutes hold 400 rows or fewer, so the 401st row is accepted and the 402nd call is refused; exact, because the recount and the insert run under one advisory lock), so at most 38,496 rows a day, about 10 MB at roughly 260 bytes per row with the index, and every insert trims up to 200 rows older than one day, so the table settles near that bound. pg_net keeps its own response log, which it trims itself.

forward_verification.name: staff_sessions_table_rls_on
forward_verification.query: select coalesce((select c.relrowsecurity from pg_class c where c.oid = to_regclass('public.guide_staff_sessions')), false)

forward_verification.name: staff_sessions_no_client_privileges
forward_verification.query: select to_regclass('public.guide_staff_sessions') is not null and not exists (select 1 from unnest(array['anon','authenticated','service_role']) r, unnest(array['select','insert','update','delete','truncate','references','trigger']) p where has_table_privilege(r, 'public.guide_staff_sessions', p))

forward_verification.name: three_functions_definer_search_path_pinned
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 3 and bool_and(p.prosecdef and p.proconfig @> array['search_path=""']) from pg_proc p where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname in ('guide_staff_session_v1','guide_secrets_v1','get_public_settings')

forward_verification.name: anon_and_authenticated_execute_service_role_not
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute')) from unnest(array['public.guide_staff_session_v1(text,text)','public.guide_secrets_v1(text)','public.get_public_settings()']::regprocedure[]) f

forward_verification.name: public_has_no_execute
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from unnest(array['public.guide_staff_session_v1(text,text)','public.guide_secrets_v1(text)','public.get_public_settings()']::regprocedure[]) f join pg_proc p on p.oid = f cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a where a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: mint_lock_timeout_secrets_volatile_settings_stable
forward_verification.query: select (select p.proconfig @> array['lock_timeout=2s'] and p.provolatile = 'v' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.guide_staff_session_v1(text,text)'::regprocedure) and (select p.provolatile = 'v' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.guide_secrets_v1(text)'::regprocedure) and (select p.provolatile = 's' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.get_public_settings()'::regprocedure)

forward_verification.name: bad_token_refused
forward_verification.query: select public.guide_secrets_v1(repeat('0', 64)) = '{"ok": false}'::jsonb and public.guide_secrets_v1(null) = '{"ok": false}'::jsonb

forward_verification.name: public_settings_whitelist_only
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(public.get_public_settings()) k where k <> all (array['wifi_ssid','house_times','min_nights','max_nights','review_airbnb_url','review_facebook_url','review_google_url','property_lat','property_lng','concierge_mode'])) = 0 and not jsonb_exists(public.get_public_settings(), 'wifi_password') and not jsonb_exists(public.get_public_settings(), 'admin_pin_hash') and not jsonb_exists(public.get_public_settings(), 'onground_phone')

forward_verification.name: weather_warm_job_scheduled
forward_verification.query: select case when to_regclass('cron.job') is null then true else (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml('select count(*) as c from cron.job where jobname = ''weather-proxy-warm'' and schedule = ''*/10 * * * *'' and active and command like ''%/functions/v1/weather-proxy%'' and command like ''%net.http_get%''', false, true, '')))[1]::text::int = 1 end

forward_verification.name: verify_admin_pin_definer_acl_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select (select p.prosecdef and p.proconfig = array['search_path=public, extensions'] and p.prorettype = 'jsonb'::regtype and pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) = 'p_code text, p_client text DEFAULT NULL::text' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)'::regprocedure) and has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)', 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p cross join lateral aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a where p.oid = 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: verify_admin_pin_address_key_trim_and_cap
forward_verification.query: select p.prosrc like '%request.headers%' and p.prosrc like '%cardinality(v_xff)%' and p.prosrc like '%interval ''1 day''%' and p.prosrc like '%skip locked%' and p.prosrc like '%> 400%' and p.prosrc like '%pg_advisory_xact_lock%' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: admin_auth_attempts_time_index
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from pg_indexes where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'admin_auth_attempts' and indexname = 'admin_auth_attempts_attempted_at_idx' and indexdef like '%(attempted_at)%')

forward_verification.name: verify_admin_pin_body_md5
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(p.prosrc, chr(13), '')) = 'b4a0aa337ba7cffac62feb7bcd633f8b' from pg_proc p where p.oid = 'public.verify_admin_pin(text,text)'::regprocedure

rollback.safe_until: Any time. Run the bound rollback FIRST (supabase/rollbacks/20261207_verify_admin_pin_bound.sql: restores the previous verify_admin_pin body byte for byte, restates its grants, drops the index), then the v9 rollback (unschedules weather-proxy-warm, drops the three functions and guide_staff_sessions). Guide v8 is not touched. Staff tokens die with the table (staff sign in again); guest tokens are guide v8 sessions and are untouched. The attempt rows already written stay (they age out by themselves only while the new body runs; after the rollback they are never trimmed, as before this release).

steps.name: rollback_clients_first
steps.action: Revert the guide v9 frontend first (it calls the new functions); until then the guide shows the stay secrets as unavailable.

steps.name: run_bound_rollback
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261207_verify_admin_pin_bound.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh; then md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) of public.verify_admin_pin(text,text) must read ca4ade3f91d42574c9176d2331e10f41, its ACL must equal the pre-release ACL and the index admin_auth_attempts_attempted_at_idx must be gone.

steps.name: run_compensating_script

compatibility.evidence: Rehearsed 2026-11-25 on host alfred with the committed harness scripts/recovery/p6/guide-v9-rehearsal.sh (fix round 2, run on the committed bytes of commit 0822fa2) on a restored copy of production backup cascade-supabase-20261125T004039Z (142 public tables, 237 ledger rows; it predates guide v8 and s136_followups, so both are applied first in the same container, as in production today). Mode full, log .rehearsal-logs/r3-final-full.log: snapshot (fingerprint of every non-release table, function body, ACL and default privilege; the live verify_admin_pin ACL seeded), migrations 20261207000000 and 20261207000100 (sha256 in migration_sha256), the 14 forward checks, the COMMITTED rollback files (supabase/rollbacks/20261207_verify_admin_pin_bound.sql then 20261207_guide_v9_secrets.sql; the log prints the committed sha256 and the sha256 of the bytes that ran and asserts them equal) with checks (no v9 object, verify_admin_pin body md5 back to ca4ade3f91d42574c9176d2331e10f41 and its ACL back to the live values, non-release fingerprint identical to the snapshot), re-apply of both, 14 checks and fingerprint equal to the first apply: 10 migrations applied, 0 failed; forward verification 14 passed, 0 failed (exit 8 only because of accepted_failing_tests). pgTAP guide_v9_secrets 84 of 84 (plan 84), guide_v8_messages_analytics 172 of 172, s136_followups 41 of 41; the seven baseline suites fail exactly the numbers in accepted_failing_tests and their 89 failure and error lines equal the run without this release (rehearsal-guide_v9-pre-full.log), diff empty. Mode cron (pg_cron and pg_net shim, log .rehearsal-logs/r3-cron.log): 4 migrations, forward checks 14 of 14 including the active job, suite 84 of 84, exit 0. The new body md5 b4a0aa337ba7cffac62feb7bcd633f8b was computed from the committed file and confirmed by the forward check verify_admin_pin_body_md5 inside the rehearsal (the live md5 read back in the first dry run was the same value). Mutation check of the NEW logic (ML-70, mode mutant, logs .rehearsal-logs/r3-mut-*.log): per-address limit 21 (7 tests fail), limit 19 (5 fail), IPv6 /64 grouping removed (2 fail), noaddr fallback removed (2 fail), staff wrapper re-raising 55P03 (1 fails): all five killed by the suite itself (migrations applied, suite ran, errors 0). The round-1 mutants (r2-mut-*.log) were run on the round-1 bytes and were not re-run on these. One mutant still survives: removing the recount after the advisory lock (R1d-no-recount); a single-transaction pgTAP cannot run two sessions, and without the recount every call that passes the unlocked pre-check while the window sits at the edge would insert, so the overshoot is bounded by the number of concurrent calls at each slide of the window, not by one row (the shipped code keeps the recount, so the cap is exact). A real 55P03 lock wait is also not exercised (one session); the suite simulates it with a trigger that raises 55P03.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (guide v8 helper or sessions table, verify_admin_pin or app_settings missing, or public.guide_staff_sessions already exists)

the rehearsal has not run the migration (apply, rollback, apply again, forward checks after each) and the suite guide_v9_secrets on this commit, or any test fails outside the accepted_failing_tests lists, or compatibility.verified is still false
the weather-proxy edge function answers 401 or 403 to a request with no headers (the warm-up sends none; the guide sends none)

the second migration guard raises 55000 (the live verify_admin_pin body is not the md5 ca4ade3f91d42574c9176d2331e10f41, or admin_auth_attempts_attempted_at_idx already exists): the live function changed since this release was written, so stop and re-derive the migration from the live body. If it fires at apply time AFTER the first migration (20261207000000) committed (the runner commits each migration on its own): KEEP the first migration live (it is no worse than today: its wrapper passes p_client straight to the old verify_admin_pin, the same exposure as the existing direct call), do NOT roll anything back, stop, re-read the live md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) of public.verify_admin_pin(text,text), and fix the guard in a NEW commit before applying the second migration
after the bound rollback the verify_admin_pin md5 is not ca4ade3f91d42574c9176d2331e10f41, or its ACL differs from the pre-release ACL
post_apply_check: Read-only, orchestrator PC, right after the apply: run supabase/sql/2026-12-07-guide-v9-verify.sql through run-sql-on-host.sh (14 rows, all t). Then one call of guide_secrets_v1 with a live guest token from the guide and one with a garbage token (ok true with kind guest, and {"ok": false}); never print the values. Staff mint: call guide_staff_session_v1 from the guide with the real PIN, read the token only into the guide. After about 10 minutes select jobname, schedule, active from cron.job where jobname = weather-proxy-warm, and one curl of the weather-proxy URL with no headers must answer 200 in under 2 seconds.

function_contract: guide_secrets_v1(p_token text) VOLATILE (POST only, so a token can never sit in a GET url): {"ok":false} for any null, malformed, unknown or expired token; a staff token is also refused once the staff code has changed (its pin_fp no longer equals md5 of the current admin_pin_hash setting); else {"ok":true,"kind":"guest"|"staff","wifi_ssid","wifi_password","onground_name","onground_phone"} (a setting that does not exist is JSON null).

guide_staff_session_v1(p_code text, p_client text default null): passes p_client straight to verify_admin_pin, which keys the throttle on the request address (cf-connecting-ip, else the rightmost x-forwarded-for entry; p_client only when there is no header address); returns the verify_admin_pin json unchanged ({"ok":false}, {"ok":false,"throttled":true}, or {"ok":true,"users":[...]}); on ok adds "token" (64 hex, 12 hours, stored with the pin_fp of the current staff code) and "expires_at"; at 50 live sessions or on a lock timeout in the mint it adds "reason":"busy" and no token (the guide signs staff in without the secrets); a lock timeout (55P03) coming out of verify_admin_pin itself returns {"ok":false,"throttled":true} instead of raising (no code was judged). Mint deletes expired rows and rows with a stale pin_fp.

get_public_settings(): one jsonb object holding only wifi_ssid, house_times, min_nights, max_nights, review_airbnb_url, review_facebook_url, review_google_url, property_lat, property_lng, concierge_mode (a key that is not set is left out).

verify_admin_pin(p_code text, p_client text default null) after 20261207000100: same signature, same return shapes ({"ok":false}, {"ok":false,"throttled":true}, {"ok":true,"users":[...]}), SECURITY DEFINER, search_path public, extensions; key = 'ip:'||address with an IPv6 address grouped by its /64 ('ip:2001:db8:1:2::/64'), IPv4 per address, the constant 'noaddr' when request.headers exists but yields no usable address, p_client only when there is no request.headers setting; hashed with the existing salt scheme; 20 failures per key in 15 minutes throttle (owner decision, was 8); null or empty code returns {"ok":false} and writes no row; with more than 400 rows in the last 15 minutes a call returns throttled and writes nothing (so 401 rows are accepted and the 402nd call is refused). The guide caches the secrets in localStorage; the guide never stores the staff token outside memory or sessionStorage.
notes.whitelists: The ten get_public_settings keys are listed in the function body and in the forward check public_settings_whitelist_only; adding a key means changing both.
